transactions.description: List of transactions to be confirmed.

amount.description: If specified, is the partial amount to be confirmed.

lines.description:
Every line of the Payment with the quantity delivered, `0` for a line not delivered. Each one is paired with a line of the Payment by your own `externalId` first and, when it is not sent, by product: `productId`, then `product.externalId`, then product name and variant, in any order; lines sharing the same product are paired in order of appearance, which is why sending your own `externalId` is the safe choice.
Prices stay the ones ordered, a discount on the whole line follows the quantity, and the discounts of the Payment are applied to the amount delivered. The one way a line can cost more than ordered is `pieces`, on a line created with `product.unit`: their amounts replace the ordered price, within what the `PreauthorizationMargin` line authorised. The line keeps what was ordered and carries the result in `confirmedQuantity`, `confirmedFinalAmount` and `confirmedPieces`. A line missing or matching no line of the Payment fails with `LINES_MISMATCH`; a quantity above the ordered one fails with `QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ORDERED`. The `PreauthorizationMargin` line is the exception: leave it out, or send it with quantity `0`.

quantity.description: The quantity delivered, from `0` to the quantity ordered.

externalId.description: Your own reference of the line, as sent at creation. It pairs the line on its own; a value that matches no line of the Payment fails with `LINES_MISMATCH`, it never falls back to the product.

productId.description: The ID of the Product of the line, when it was created with one.

product.description: The product the line was created with, to pair it by product when the line is sent without its own ids.

externalId.description: The external reference of the product, as sent in `product.externalId` at creation.

pieces.description: One entry per item delivered, only on a line created with `product.unit`, as many as `quantity`. Send it when the amount charged differs from the ordered price, as it does with variable-weight items; without it the line is accounted at the ordered price. Fails with `PIECES_NOT_ALLOWED` on a line without `product.unit`, and with `PIECES_COUNT_MISMATCH` when the count differs from `quantity`.

items.description: One item delivered on a line sold by measure, with the amount charged for it.

finalAmount.description: The amount charged for this piece, in cents, net of any discount. It is taken as it is, and it may exceed the ordered price.

size.description: The measured content of the piece, in the unit of `unit.code`. Printed on the documents, never used to compute anything.

items.title: Payments.PaymentLine.Piece

finalAmount.description: The amount to confirm, in cents. It only drives what is captured, voided and given back on the transactions. Requires `foodAmount`.

foodAmount.description: The part of `finalAmount` that meal vouchers can pay, in cents. Requires `finalAmount`, and can't be higher than it.

refundMode.description:
How money already captured is given back when the confirmed amounts are lower than what was captured. Authorizations are never refunded: they are captured partially or voided.
- `NoRefund` (default): nothing is given back, and the request fails with `REFUND_REQUIRED` without touching any transaction.
- `Gateway`: refunded through the payment gateway. When its configuration forbids a partial refund, the request fails before touching any transaction; when the gateway itself refuses the refund it has already been asked for, the captures of this confirmation are done and `operations` lists them.
- `Credit`: credited to the customer's wallet, without calling the gateway. A credit coming from meal vouchers can be spent only on food.
- `GatewayOrCredit`: refunded through the gateway where it allows it, credited to the wallet otherwise.
refundMode.title: Payments.RefundMode

schema.title: ConfirmPaymentRequest

Full.summary: Capture every authorized transaction in full

Delivered lines.summary: Confirm the quantities delivered, crediting to the wallet the meal vouchers exceeding the food amount

Weighed pieces.summary: Confirm two packs of plums at the weight delivered, pairing the lines by your own line ids and releasing the preauthorization margin

Amounts.summary: Confirm lower amounts without resending the lines
